title: Filolial And Weasel
paragraphs: “Hey, do you know about Keel’s changes?”
“Of course I do. He can finally turn back into a dog from a pig.”
“From a pig to a dog…”
Huh? Did I say something wrong? Just then, Ren and Itsuki showed up.
“Wasn’t it that he sees women as pigs?”
“Didn’t he say the villagers were exceptions?”
“When Keel went into the hot springs, we confirmed that he’s a girl, but… turning back from a pig to a dog?”
“I transformed! I didn’t turn back!”
Keel barked loudly, protesting. I wouldn’t know.
“And why do Raphtalia and the others get to stay as they are and let the spear guy look at them? It’s not fair!”
Keel barked again. Haha, what a funny little dog. There’s no way I would mistake Filo-tan’s big sister and her friend for pigs.
“Well, well… Motoyasu-kun seems to live by his own values. I’m sure he has his reasons, considering all the loops and everything.”
“Ugh… it still doesn’t sit right with me!”
“By the way, how did you learn how to turn back?”
If I recall correctly, Keel learned how to revert back in Siltvelt during the previous loop, thanks to Panda’s help.
“I taught him. He had the talent for it.”
Big sister came over while tending to the slaves.
“Hehe! Now we can get even stronger!”
“Yeah. But the activation event is still a bit off, isn’t it?”
“Leveling up doesn’t have to wait for an activation event, though.”
Father nodded at Ren’s words.
“Yeah, that’s true.”

At that moment… Big sister came over, holding hands with a weasel beastman. The weasel beastman was about the same height as Keel in his dog form. I think it’s a weasel, but I can’t tell for sure. Come to think of it, I feel like I saw a weasel monster somewhere in the previous loop. Well, it’s probably just a coincidence.
“Welcome back, Spear Hero.”
“Welcome back.”
Big sister and the weasel beastman greeted me.
“When did we get more people?”
I pointed at the weasel beastman. Father waved his hand.
“No, no.”
“Oh, I forgot to mention this.”
The weasel beastman glowed and transformed. Standing there was Raphtalia’s friend.
“Just like Keel, Rifana-chan also has the talent.”
“I’ve gotten a lot faster.”
Puffing out her chest proudly, Raphtalia’s friend answered.
Oh… so she had this kind of talent.
“Earlier, I saw you carrying Raphtalia on your back while running. How was it?”
“Um… it was heavy, wasn’t it?”
“I told you it was fine!”
Big sister and her friend were giggling and playing around. Judging by appearances… this is the kind of change Luna-chan would love.
“Rifana-chan is getting pretty strong now.”
“Yeah. She’s probably one of the fastest in the village. I’m not sure how she compares to the Filolials, though.”
“Earlier, she was playing around with Kou, right?”
Kou wanted to help out big sister and the others in the village, so he stayed behind with Sakura-chan.
“Yeah! We were doing a mock battle! Want to watch?”
“Wanna join?”
Kou was called over and came skipping happily.
“Alright, let’s see it then.”
“Okay!”

Kou transformed into his Filolial form, and big sister’s friend shifted into her weasel beastman form, taking her stance. It looks like she’s going for a claw-based fighting style. Kou and big sister’s friend slowly closed the distance between them.
Hmm? Kou’s eyes look like he’s spotted prey… or is it just my imagination? Eventually, both of them moved and clashed.
“Oh! Oh! Kuh! Toh!”

Kou tried to dodge and kick big sister’s friend, but he got caught by a feint when she lunged in with a sidestep, tackling him easily. Kou’s kick sliced through the air in vain as big sister’s friend jumped onto his wings, lightly running her fingers through his feathers.
Fwoosh! She combed through Kou’s feathers with her hands before quickly leaping back from Kou, who was about to counterattack.
“That’s one hit on your wings!”
“Ugh… but I’m not giving up!”
Kou charged in again, refusing to back down. Big sister’s friend switched to a four-legged form and smoothly circled around to Kou’s back, hopping onto him. That was incredibly fast.
“Gotcha, Kou-kun!”
Then, big sister’s friend hugged Kou’s neck and buried her face into his feathers.
“Ahh! Kou lost!”
“That was a heartwarming yet wild mock battle.”
“Yeah… it kind of looked like a weasel going after a chicken.”
“Right. At the initial clash, Rifana-san clipped his wings, then circled around when he recklessly charged in, pounced from behind, and landed a strike on his neck! That’s how it looked.”
“Ahaha…”
They were playfully messing around, but Kou definitely looked like he had been hunted by big sister’s friend.
“Rifana-chan, that was awesome! I won’t lose either!”
“Hm? Keel-kun, you wanna go too?”
“Hell yeah! Bring it on!”
Kou was looking at Keel’s entire body as if he were prey.
Should I intervene? It would be best to do something before Father scolds Kou.
“Kou, don’t even think about going after Keel’s tail. If you do, Father will get really mad, and it’ll be terrifying.”
“Huh!? Kou, are you eyeing my tail like food!?”
Keel looked at me.
“From what Motoyasu says, Keel-kun has a tendency to be targeted, right?”
“I’m not gonna be anyone’s snack!”
Keel protested, but Kou shook his head.
“Hmm? I wouldn’t do that. Rifana and Raphtalia would get mad.”
Kou hugged big sister and her friend with a fluffy embrace, looking very pleased.
“That tickles, Kou.”
“Ehehe.”
“Ah, haha…”
Big sister patted Kou, looking a little embarrassed. For some reason, this time Kou didn’t see Keel’s tail or big sister’s friend, who turns into a weasel beastman like a mole, as prey.
“I’d be scared if Rifana bit me.”
So that’s how it is.
“Well, things seem pretty peaceful overall. By the way, Motoyasu, Éclair was looking for you, so it’d be good if you could go see her later.”
“Understood.”

I immediately went to meet Éclair in the neighboring town. The matter was about gathering evidence to corner the Three Hero Church and preparing to storm their stronghold. Ah, right. I had completely forgotten about that. I used a portal to head there. —That evening. After leaving Father and the others in the village, I went to the tower where Trash was imprisoned. The moment Trash saw me, his face twisted in anger, and he clenched his fists, marching toward me. He’s clearly gathering his strength.
“You’ve got some nerve showing your face here! You fake Spear Hero!”
“I am the Love Hunter. I see through all your schemes!”
It seems there isn’t an ounce of remorse for trapping Father. I let him live last time because killing him caused unnecessary problems, but honestly, I would have preferred to finish him off.
“The Shield is evil! Anyone who doesn’t see that deserves death! How can you not understand!? Even what happened to Malty is all your fault!”
“You’re way off the mark. Trapping Father is never the right thing to do.”

The Four Cardinal Heroes are precious defenders against the Waves and the world’s hope. Despite that, because he disliked one of the heroes, he deceived and persecuted the others along with him. Such foolishness. You summoned us and begged us to save your world.
How many times do I have to tell you not to get carried away? And as for that pig… killing her is an undeniable truth. You want to blame us? The fact that she’s still alive is the real mistake.
“Well, Trash, I didn’t come here to argue with you today.”
“Argue? What are you talking about!? You’re here so I can kill you!”
It seems Trash is determined to keep fighting. But I don’t have time for this, so I’ll wrap this up quickly.
“I brought a gift, by the way.”
“Hey! Why did you bring us to this noisy old man!?”
Fohl voiced his complaint, peeking out from behind me.
